senses.gloss:
Paippala
pāñcarātra. one of the tantras enumerated in Bhāradvājasam3hitā, MT. 1343 (c).

Paippalādasaṃhitā
Av. See Atharvavedasam3hitā Paippalādaśākhā, NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 111.
Addl. references:
For a critical examination of some readings of the Paippalādasam3hitā (Kāṇḍas II an. IV) see Hukum Chand Patyal, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. XXI. p. 275 an. XXIII. p. 261 an. for a. study of Kāṇḍa III. see Hukumchand Patyal, Charudeva Sastri Fel. Vol. p.. 125-132.
On the reconstruction of the authentic Paippalādasam3hitā, see Michael Witzel, J. of G. Jha Res. Inst. XXIX. Pt.. 1-4. 1973. p.. 463-488; XXXII. Pt.. 1-4. 1976. p.. 137-168.
Addl. Pt.. reference:
Ed. by Dipak Bhattacharya. Cal. Skt. Ser. 62. (Kāṇḍas II-IV) 1970.

Paippalādopaniṣad
Av. Trav. Uni. 3348D. 3521E. See Śarabhopaniṣad.
